brief_title: PK Study of Dapagliflozin in Pediatric Subjects With T2DM
official_title: A Randomized, Multi-Center, Parallel Group, Single-Dose, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics Study of Dapagliflozin in Children and Adolescents Aged 10 to 17 Years With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

primary_outcomes.measure: Geometric Mean of Maximum Observed Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of Dapagliflozin
primary_outcomes.time_frame: 11 time points: Immediately pre-dose, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 4, 8, 12, 14, 24, and 48 hours post-dose

brief_summary: The primary purpose of this study is to evaluate the pharmacokinetics (PK) of Dapagliflozin in pediatric subjects with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of T2DM
* Male and female subjects ages 10-17
* Glycosylated Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) ≥6 to 10%
* Body weight ≥30 kg

Exclusion Criteria:

* Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) \>240 mg/dL at screening
* Abnormal renal function
* Active liver disease and/or significant abnormal liver function
